evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml (step1.patch 55-100) runs on `pull_request` and pushes to main. It runs `npm ci`, `npm test` and `npm run build` in `site/`, and all of those scripts exist in app/site/package.json:8-17. Every action is pinned to a 40-character SHA with a version comment. Permissions are `contents: read` at the top. In pages.yml only the deploy job gets `pages: write` and `id-token: write`, release.yml grants `contents: write` only at job level, and pr-title.yml has `permissions: {}` and passes the PR title through an env var, not inline interpolation. The only token used is `github.token`, and there is no `pull_request_target`. pages.yml deploys on push to main plus `workflow_dispatch`. Manual dispatch from another branch is only blocked by the github-pages environment's default branch rule, which RELEASING.md mentions. The build job calls `actions/configure-pages` with only `contents: read`, which may not be enough for its Pages API call. Nothing was run or published, and no application code changed (vite.config.ts:11 already read PAGES_BASE).
evidence.s1_readme: README (step1.patch 425-553) covers requirements, install (`npm ci`), develop (`npm run dev`, `index`, `fieldsets`, `prepare-data`), test (`npm test`, `npm test -- src/lib/data.test.ts`, and that file exists), build and preview (`npm run build`, `npm run preview`, `PAGES_BASE=...`), the CI overview, data contribution with sourcing rules and the record-count caveat, the commit convention, releases and the license. Every script it shows exists in site/package.json. The files it links (LICENSE as MIT, THIRD-PARTY.md, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE, data/bullets/README.md, site/package-lock.json) all exist in app/.
evidence.s1_release: The strategy is consistent. The version lives in site/package.json, and package-lock follows it. A release is a `v*.*.*` tag on main. release.yml runs scripts/release-notes.mjs, which checks the tag, package.json, package-lock and the dated CHANGELOG heading against each other, then publishes the changelog section with `gh release create`. CHANGELOG.md states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 and SemVer, and RELEASING.md gives the steps and how commit types map to version bumps. Dependabot covers npm in /site and github-actions in /. All 7 commits in commits.txt are Conventional Commits. There are small inconsistencies: CONTRIBUTING's table assigns dependency changes to `build`, but dependabot.yml uses prefix `chore`, which gives `chore(deps)`; and the commit that adds the Dependabot config is typed `build(deps)` although the table assigns `.github/` automation to `ci`.
evidence.s2_requirements: Route: router.ts adds `#/compare/<a>/<b>` with keys encoded separately, and the hash is parsed on load, so it survives a reload. The SVG has `role="img"` and `aria-label` from `compare.profiles` ('Profiles of {a} and {b}'). It holds one `<path>` per case, drawn with one viewport at scale 1 and both head faces at z=0 (Compare.svelte, compare.ts `overlay`). Shot cartridges are excluded (`outerProfile` returns null). The table has a `<caption>` 'Dimensions (mm|in)' and the headers Symbol / A name / B name / Difference. Its rows come from `cartridge` numbers with no FIELD_UNITS entry and without `Tol` fields, use FIELD_LABELS symbols, and Difference is B−A. Units follow `unitSystem()`, the 'Default units' preference: metric uses formatValue, imperial uses `displayNumber(v,'in')`. Cartridge.svelte adds a select labelled 'Compare with' (Label for/id) listing the other entries by name, and a 'Compare' button that sets `href.compare(key, chosen)`. German texts were added for every key. No requirement is unmet.
evidence.s2_correctness: On 308 Win. vs 300 Win. Mag., `dimensionsOf` gives the detail-page order and drops α, β, δ, the pressures and the `Tol` fields (data/cartridges/rimless/308_win.json). `difference` subtracts in decimal (11.96→12.01 gives 0.05, not 0.0500…07) and leaves the record's own precision alone. Imperial values and differences use displayNumber with no extra rounding (test: '2.01496062992'). In the overlay, both min-x values equal headX, both outlines are symmetric about axisY, and the lengths match L3 and the 308 width matches R1 = 12.01 (compare.test.ts). ScaleRuler is fed correctly for mm (`widthMm`) and inches (`unitsPerUnit=25.4`). Edge cases are handled: shot or undrawable records show a note instead of the drawing, unknown keys reach the catch branch, and malformed or partial routes fall back to the list.
evidence.s2_fit: The feature reuses `caseOuterProfile`/`adaptMetallic` (lib/shapes2d), `viewportFor`/`fullSectionPath` (lib/geom), `FIELD_LABELS`/`FIELD_UNITS`/`GROUP_ORDER`/`orderedFields`/`formatValue` (lib/core), and the site's PageHeader, ScaleRuler, NativeSelect, Label, Button, `load`, `unitSystem` and `displayNumber`. It follows UI.md's `data-ui` scoping and `@layer legacy`, adds a lazy route chunk, and updates metadata and the nav active state. The changes are focused. Minor points: compare.ts:289-292 re-implements the group ordering of site/src/lib/fields.ts `orderedGroups`. The `.compare-bar [data-slot=native-select-wrapper] { width:auto }` rule sits in the legacy layer, so the wrapper's Tailwind `w-full` utility overrides it.
evidence.s2_tests: compare.test.ts tests the lib on real records: the dimension selection (no Tol fields, no FIELD_UNITS fields, no chamber values, symbols, odd shapes), decimal difference, metric and imperial rows, the zero difference, profile identity with caseOuterProfile, the shotshell null, and the overlay geometry (head faces aligned, one axis, scale 1, closed paths). It also checks the English and German texts. router.test.ts covers parsing, round-tripping encoded keys and the invalid compare hashes. The tests use the existing vitest setup, which has no component-test infrastructure, so the Compare.svelte markup (caption, headers, aria wiring) and the Cartridge select/button are not tested.
evidence.s3_fixes: Point 1: `compareRows` now merges both symbol lists. Symbols only B publishes go after their predecessor in B, and the missing cell and Difference are empty strings (step3.patch 100-140). New tests check `delta L` (308 only) and `R3` (300 WM only), the empty cells, the ordering, and the case with no shared dimension. Point 2: step 2 had already right-aligned the numeric `th` and `td` and kept only the Symbol column left-aligned (app/site/src/routes/Compare.svelte:139-141, in the legacy layer that page styles use), matching GroupTable. So no change was needed, but step 3 neither touched it nor mentioned it in the commit. Related text changes (the lede, `noShared` in English and German) follow from the fix. The changelog edit leaves an awkward line break ('units. It opens' / 'from the …').
evidence.cross_step: Step 2 adds an Added entry under `## [Unreleased]`, and step 3 amends that same unreleased entry, which suits an unreleased feature under Keep a Changelog. The stated strategy bumps the version only when a release is made, so leaving site/package.json at 0.1.0 is consistent. The commits `feat(site): compare two cartridges` and `fix(site): list every dimension in the cartridge comparison` follow the convention. The new code uses only existing imports and types that look sound under strict/noUncheckedIndexedAccess, and the tests use the vitest include paths, so the CI checks would likely pass. I could not run them.

strengths: The compare view meets every written requirement and reuses the right modules (lib/shapes2d `caseOuterProfile`, lib/geom `viewportFor`/`fullSectionPath`, lib/core field tables and `formatValue`, the site's PageHeader, ScaleRuler and NativeSelect), with decimal-correct differences and correct imperial conversion.

The CI, Pages and release setup is careful: actions pinned to SHAs, least-privilege permissions, safe PR-title handling, and a release workflow that checks the tag, package.json, package-lock and CHANGELOG against each other via a small script before publishing.
The tests run on real data, check the overlay geometry (head faces aligned, one axis, scale 1), units, edge routes and the German texts, and step 3 adds focused tests for `delta L` and `R3`.
issues: Step 3 did nothing explicit for the alignment point. The step 2 CSS already right-aligns the numeric columns (Compare.svelte:139-141), but the agent neither checked this in a test nor mentioned it in the commit.

pages.yml runs `actions/configure-pages` in a job that has only `contents: read`, which may not be enough for its Pages API call. `workflow_dispatch` lets the workflow be dispatched from any branch, relying on the environment's branch rule to stop a deploy.

Small inconsistencies: Dependabot commits are `chore(deps)` although CONTRIBUTING assigns dependency changes to `build`; compare.ts duplicates the `orderedGroups` ordering logic; the compare-bar `width:auto` rule is overridden by Tailwind `w-full`; and the step 3 changelog has an awkward line break.
review.verdict: The work is high quality: the repository setup is secure and consistent, and the compare feature is correct, meets every requirement of step 2, and reuses the existing libraries, with meaningful tests. The deductions are minor: step 3 did not explicitly address the alignment point (already satisfied by the step 2 CSS), a possible permissions gap in the Pages workflow, and small convention and duplication inconsistencies.
